description (spoiler warning for super redacted story content):

Spoilersilly little sidbar plugin that helps locating threat fleets

only enabled enabled after finding the onslaught mk1, or obtaining threat detection mem flag through other means

only active when panel is added to sidebar, remove panel to turn it off

when active will check current system for any threat fleets in it

will beep at you if there are any in system

will beep faster the closer you are to any of them

only tracks one closest fleet at a time

aiDescription: This mod adds a sidebar plugin that helps locate threat fleets in the current system. It activates only after finding the Onslaught Mk1 or obtaining the threat detection mem flag, and beeps faster as the player gets closer to the closest tracked fleet.
